queries: WITH c AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), s AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, CAST(telescope_count AS REAL) / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share FROM c), d AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS diff FROM s), r AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY diff DESC) AS rk FROM d) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, diff FROM r WHERE rk <= 10 ORDER BY diff DESC, observstation;

responses.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), s AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, CAST(telescope_count AS REAL) / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share FROM c), d AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS diff FROM s), r AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY diff DESC) AS rk FROM d) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, diff FROM r WHERE rk <= 10 ORDER BY diff DESC, observstation;

assumptions.assumption: Observatories are those that appear in the telescopes table (grouped by telescopes.observstation). Observatories in the observatories table with no telescopes are not counted in the average.
Ties at 10th place are handled with RANK() on the difference, so every row tied with the 10th row is included.
The average share is the mean of the per-observatory shares, which equals 1 divided by the number of observatories.

Ties at 10th place are handled with RANK() over the difference, so every row tied with the 10th-ranked difference is kept.
